psychological_meaning: Smoky colors evoke a sense of sophistication, mystery, and calmness. They can represent neutrality, subtlety, and a quiet strength. These colors often bring feelings of groundedness and stability, while also hinting at hidden depths and unexplored potential. Smoky hues are associated with introspection and contemplation, suggesting a thoughtful and reserved nature.
